findings.controlled_scope: Only observe_bound_remote simulates exact live W; all envelope, authority, WU, Git candidate and completion helper checks use native frozen source and real Stage5 artifacts. No publication or formal POST claim. No project mutation.
findings.impact: A PASS marker with no completed process, no successful exit, null execution counts, an unexecuted scope or unfinished validators can derive a synchronized STATE candidate at revision48. The helper does not itself write STATE or complete WU, but the explicit independent POST prerequisite to finalization is bypassed.
findings.observed: The finalizer composes Result schema and validate_review_result but omits validate_completion_evidence. Against the immutable Stage5 bindings, positive POST is accepted and each of five semantically incomplete completion variants is also accepted; native completion helper rejects each with PASS_COMPLETION_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE.
findings.recommendation: Compose the existing Result protocol/completion semantics at the finalizer before accepting independent POST. Preserve zero-test management and valid complete POST. No schema or scope expansion.
findings.title: Exact-W finalizer accepts incomplete independent POST completion evidence
